missions.title: Recover legacy referential integrity
missions.problem: The retained corpus contains 6,990 dangling rows across 2,035 IDs.
missions.done_when: The recovery gate is independently verified against the frozen evidence snapshot.

missions.title: Build the isolated run-centered parsing foundation
missions.problem: The previous schema could not represent field-level evidence, run outcomes, or multi-artifact fetches.
missions.done_when: Schema, queue, artifact store, field observations and terminal-state tests pass in an isolated database.

missions.title: Freeze a measurable source universe
missions.problem: Comprehensive coverage cannot be stated without a versioned eligible route denominator.
missions.done_when: Every pilot source and route has eligibility, policy review, expected-record basis and a frozen universe version.

missions.title: Prove five parsing archetypes
missions.problem: A single static HTML route does not validate a comprehensive parsing instrument.
missions.done_when: Download, structured, paginated, PDF and client-rendered routes each pass fixtures, reconciliation and replay.

missions.title: Open production materialization
missions.problem: Legacy integrity and parsing capability must converge without contaminating each other.
missions.done_when: M-000, M-100, M-110 and M-120 are complete and a production merge rehearsal passes all invariants.
